text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan was defeated in the Shuka 
Sho... The spectators are buzzing with 
excitement watching the rivalry between 
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan made up her mind. If just 
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka clashing was 
enough to send race expectations soaring—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to make even more headlines than 
those two. First, a run to remember at the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! Together with 
Trainer, she fired herself up.
